source: FlyWire 783 connectome; Brian2 LIF model of Shiu et al.

experiments.label: Sugar GRNs
experiments.note: Labellar sugar-sensing gustatory receptor neurons. Shiu et al. report that driving these makes the MN9 proboscis motor neurons fire - the fly sticks out its tongue.

experiments.label: Bitter GRNs
experiments.note: Bitter-sensing gustatory receptor neurons: aversive taste, suppresses feeding.

experiments.label: Sugar + bitter GRNs
experiments.note: Both taste channels at once. Bitter input gates the sugar-driven proboscis response.

experiments.label: LC4 looming detectors
experiments.note: Lobula columnar type 4 cells, the looming-sensitive visual projection neurons that feed the Giant Fiber escape pathway.

experiments.label: Or56a olfactory (geosmin)
experiments.note: Or56a receptor neurons detect geosmin, a mould marker. Aversive: drives avoidance.

experiments.label: Johnston organ (all)
experiments.note: Johnston's organ neurons in the antenna: vibration and touch, trigger grooming.

experiments.label: Johnston organ EV
experiments.note: JO_EV subtype of Johnston organ mechanosensory neurons.

experiments.label: Johnston organ EVP
experiments.note: JO_EVP subtype of Johnston organ mechanosensory neurons.

experiments.label: P9 (forward walking)

experiments.label: MDN (backward walking)

experiments.label: Giant Fiber (escape)
